occurrences.text: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar, which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
